title: Consequences of Peptide Macrocyclization Revealed by Virus-Inspired beta-Hairpin Mimetics.
authors: Bula, Anna L; Bobrovs, Raitis; Arsenyan, Pavel; Pantelejevs, Teodors
one_liner_zh: 该文研究病毒来源β-发夹模拟肽大环化对STAT1转录因子结合的热力学与动力学影响，涉及蛋白-核酸互作界面，但核心是肽类抑制剂设计而非TF-DNA结合建模，方法上无AI或物理模拟，仅部分相关。
abstract: Mimicry of protein secondary structure elements, such as alpha-helices and beta-sheets, using conformationally constrained peptide macrocycles, can be utilized to disrupt native protein-protein and protein-nucleic acid interactions. Although alpha-helical stapled peptides have been extensively studied as pharmacological probes, the application of beta-sheet and beta-hairpin mimetics remains comparatively limited. Less is known about the structural and biophysical consequences of beta-hairpin macrocyclization in the context of target binding. In this work, we use a poxvirus immune antagonist protein 018 as a template for the structure-based design of beta-hairpin mimetic macrocyclic peptides targeting the STAT1 transcription factor. We demonstrate that successive orthogonal cyclizations have additive effects on the thermodynamic and kinetic properties of peptide binding, most notably slowing the dissociation from the target. We elucidate the structural and dynamic consequences of interstrand and head-to-tail cross-linking and propose a kinetic model explaining the gains in target residence. Finally, we highlight the pharmacological potential of these peptides by competitive inhibition of STAT1 binding to its cognate interferon receptor docking site. These data suggest that beta-hairpin macrocyclization may represent a general strategy to extend target engagement, with implications for peptidic probe design.
abstract_zh: 利用构象受限的肽大环化合物模拟蛋白质二级结构元件（如α-螺旋和β-折叠），可用于破坏天然蛋白质-蛋白质及蛋白质-核酸相互作用。尽管α-螺旋订书肽作为药理学探针已被广泛研究，但β-折叠和β-发夹模拟物的应用仍相对有限。在靶标结合背景下，关于β-发夹大环化对结构和生物物理性质的影响知之甚少。在本工作中，我们以痘病毒免疫拮抗剂蛋白018为模板，进行基于结构的β-发夹模拟大环肽设计，靶向STAT1转录因子。我们证明，连续的正交环化对肽结合的热力学和动力学性质具有加性效应，尤其显著减缓了与靶标的解离。我们阐明了链间及头尾交联的结构和动态后果，并提出一个动力学模型来解释靶标驻留时间的增加。最后，通过竞争性抑制STAT1与其同源干扰素受体对接位点的结合，我们强调了这些肽的药理学潜力。这些数据表明，β-发夹大环化可能代表一种延长靶标结合的通用策略，对肽类探针设计具有重要意义。
